sourceChecks.title: Selective laser trabeculoplasty versus medical therapy as initial treatment of glaucoma: a prospective, randomized trial
sourceChecks.excerpt: IOP reduction was similar in both arms
sourceChecks.paraphrase: A randomized trial in open-angle glaucoma/ocular hypertension found similar IOP reduction with SLT and medication at 9–12 months.
sourceChecks.limitations: Small study with incomplete follow-up; no ganglion-cell regeneration, permanent normalization, angle-closure result, or one-time cure.

sourceChecks.title: In vivo high resolution human retinal imaging with wavefront correctionless full-field OCT
sourceChecks.excerpt: we demonstrate high resolution en face full-field OCT (FFOCT) retinal imaging without wavefront correction
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Primary preprint authors report in-vivo human wavefront-correctionless FFOCT with SDOCT path-length matching and photoreceptor-mosaic detail. Not independent replication or complete universal disease imaging.
sourceChecks.limitations: Preprint demonstration does not establish practical affordability, routine utility, or visualization of individual RPE and ganglion cells at the claimed scope.

sourceChecks.title: Efficacy and Safety of 0.01% and 0.02% Atropine for the Treatment of Pediatric Myopia Progression Over 3 Years: A Randomized Clinical Trial
sourceChecks.excerpt: 0.02% atropine did not significantly increase the proportion of participants’ eyes responding to therapy
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Three-year pediatric trial found no significant 0.02% benefit on responder proportion or mean refractive progression, while 0.01% showed benefits across the three main endpoints. This is dose- and population-specific slowing, not complete cessation.
sourceChecks.limitations: The treatment reduced but did not eliminate progression; dose-specific responder findings and adverse effects limit “complete halt/no side effects.”

sourceChecks.title: Induced pluripotent stem-cell-derived corneal epithelium for transplant surgery: a single-arm, open-label, first-in-human interventional study in Japan
sourceChecks.paraphrase: First-in-human iPSC-derived corneal epithelial cell sheets were transplanted in four LSCD patients; improvements in stage/visual acuity were recorded at 52 weeks, with no serious adverse event over two years.
sourceChecks.limitations: Small single-arm study addresses epithelial deficiency, not a whole patient-specific cornea, innervation, lifelong transparency, rejection-free integration, or donor shortages.

sourceChecks.title: Archway Randomized Phase 3 Trial of the Port Delivery System with Ranibizumab for Neovascular Age-Related Macular Degeneration
sourceChecks.paraphrase: Phase 3 trial found ranibizumab port delivery with 24-week refill exchanges noninferior to monthly injections in nAMD over the initial 24-week interval.
sourceChecks.limitations: One drug/disease and refill interval; not 2–5 years, no gene therapies or zero burst release, and ocular adverse events occurred. In this trial, prespecified ocular adverse events of special interest occurred in 19.0% of implant versus 6.0% of monthly-injection patients; finite studied follow-up and repeat refills.

sourceChecks.title: MSC Transplantation Improves Lacrimal Gland Regeneration after Surgically Induced Dry Eye Disease in Mice
sourceChecks.excerpt: MSC transplantation significantly improved LG regeneration
sourceChecks.paraphrase: In a mouse duct-ligation dry-eye model, MSC transplantation increased viable acinar structures and altered immune markers.
sourceChecks.limitations: Mouse disease model; not a human molecular cure or evidence of restored normal tear film/long-term vision.

items.corrections: A targeted search located a specific retinal-regeneration primary paper, but its page was blocked; the supplied milestone is therefore not assessable from accessible evidence.
A randomized trial supports SLT as an initial IOP-lowering option for open-angle glaucoma/ocular hypertension; it does not establish a permanent cure.
An arXiv primary preprint reports wavefront-correctionless in-vivo human retinal OCT imaging with photoreceptor-mosaic detail, a narrow imaging demonstration.
The bounded search did not locate a readable primary study establishing one durable platform for all inherited retinal dystrophies.
A three-year randomized pediatric trial tested low-dose atropine and measured myopia progression; evidence was dose-specific and did not show a complete halt.
A four-eye first-in-human study transplanted iPSC-derived corneal epithelial sheets for LSCD, a limited surface-tissue milestone.
The targeted search did not locate an opened primary study demonstrating molecular-guided real-time tumor margins with non-thermal ocular-tumor ablation.
The phase 3 Archway study tested a ranibizumab implant with refill exchange every 24 weeks and found efficacy noninferior to monthly injections in nAMD.
A mouse model study reported MSC-associated lacrimal-gland regeneration markers and increased viable acinar structures.
A specific prospective clinical study of the PRIMA subretinal implant was located, but the opened primary page was unreadable; the claimed acuity and field thresholds cannot be assessed here.

notes: All six positively used URLs independently reopened; exact titles/topics/results match.
